name: Agender
description: A person who does not identify with any gender.

name: Bigender
description: A person who identifies as two genders, either simultaneously or switching between them.

name: Cisgender
description: A person whose gender identity aligns with the sex they were assigned at birth.

name: Demiboy
description: Someone who partially identifies as a boy or man.

name: Demigirl
description: Someone who partially identifies as a girl or woman.

name: Genderfluid
description: A person whose gender identity shifts or changes over time.

name: Genderqueer
description: A gender identity that exists outside the binary of male and female.

name: Maverique
description: A nonbinary gender characterized by autonomy and inner conviction, not tied to masculinity or femininity.

name: Neutrois
description: A neutral or null gender identity often associated with a desire to minimize gendered expression.

name: Nonbinary
description: An umbrella term for gender identities outside the male/female binary.

name: Pangender
description: A person who identifies with many or all genders.

name: Two-Spirit
description: A sacred, culturally specific identity used by some Indigenous North American peoples to describe a person with both masculine and feminine spirit.

name: Male
description: A man or someone who identifies with masculinity.

name: Female
description: A woman or someone who identifies with femininity.
